params.1273: Traverse obstacles to gather tickets from pillars spaced throughout the arena.
params.1292: Gives tickets, which can be exchanged for rare herbs and Agility experience.
params.1274: You may brave the arena as often as you wish.
params.1275: Talk to Izzy No-Beard or Jackie the Fruit in the arena lobby to learn more.
params.1276: It costs 200 coins to enter the arena.
params.1277: At 20 and 40 Agility, you will be able to attempt more obstacles in the arena.
